Name: Center right
Current description: A moderate position right of center, supporting conservative social and economic policies while staying close to the political mainstream.

Name: Center left
Current description: A moderate position left of center, supporting liberal social and economic policies while staying close to the political mainstream.

Name: Left
Current description: A position on the left of the political spectrum, favoring social equality, expanded government programs and progressive social policy.

Name: Right
Current description: A position on the right of the political spectrum, favoring limited government, free markets, traditional values and strong national defense.

Name: Nonpartisan
Comments: For entities that claim no side (wire services, fact-checkers, courts). Off the 1-7 scale.

Name: Far right
Alternative names: Radical right; Hard right; Extreme right
Current description: A position at the right extreme of the political spectrum, marked by ultranationalism, nativism and hostility to pluralist institutions.

Name: Center
Alternative names: Centrist; Moderate; Middle of the road
Current description: A position near the middle of the political spectrum, balancing left and right perspectives without a consistent ideological tilt.

Name: Far left
Alternative names: Radical left; Hard left; Extreme left
Current description: A position at the left extreme of the political spectrum, favoring radical economic redistribution and systemic change, often through anti-capitalist or revolutionary politics.
